data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that auto‑scrolls overflowing text like a marquee.
data.what_it_does: TextScroll displays a single line of text and scrolls it when the content is wider than its container. It supports endless looping or bouncing back and forth, with configurable speed, delays, repetitions, and fade edges.
use_when: You need a simple marquee effect for a single line of text
You want built‑in support for bouncing or endless scrolling without custom animation code
avoid_when: You require multi‑line scrolling or complex rich‑text layouts
You need precise pixel‑perfect control over animation curves
strengths: Easy to drop‑in as a regular widget
Configurable modes, speed, delays, and fade edges
Handles parameter changes and disposes timers correctly
weaknesses: No support for custom animation curves or multi‑line marquee

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Automatically scales text to fit its bounds, avoiding the need for scrolling when possible
